name: Switch
description: A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch. It replaces the earlier Toggle with a real, labelled switch control.
whenToUse: To turn a setting on or off that takes effect right away, e.g. "Email notifications".
In settings lists where each row controls one independent option.

whenNotToUse.text: When the change only applies after pressing Save or Submit.
To choose one option from several.
To trigger an action such as "Refresh".

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: The pill-shaped control; its color shows on (brand) or off (neutral).

anatomy.name: Thumb
anatomy.description: Slides to the end when on, to the start when off.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Says what the switch controls; clicking it toggles the switch.

values.meaning: Label after the switch. Default for standalone switches.
Label before the switch, aligned edge to edge in settings lists.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: Shows the switch responds to the pointer.

states.name: Disabled
states.meaning: The setting cannot be changed right now.

behavior.text: Changing a switch applies the setting at once; don’t pair switches with a Save button.
Pass checked and onCheckedChange to control it, or defaultChecked to let it manage its own state.
With a name, it submits its value in native forms like a checkbox.
The thumb slides toward the start in Arabic, so "on" is always toward the end of the reading direction.

content: Label the setting, not the action: "Email notifications", not "Turn on email notifications".
Keep labels short and in sentence case.
Don’t put on/off state words in the label; the switch shows the state.

guidelines.do: Use a switch for settings that apply immediately.
guidelines.dont: Use a switch inside a form that is applied with a Save button.
guidelines.why: People expect a switch to take effect at once; a delayed change is surprising.

guidelines.do: Give every switch a visible label.
guidelines.dont: Rely on surrounding text without connecting it to the switch.
guidelines.why: The label is the accessible name, and clicking it should toggle the switch.

guidelines.do: Label the setting positively, e.g. "Show preview".
guidelines.dont: Use negative labels such as "Hide preview".
guidelines.why: On should mean the thing is on; double negatives are hard to read.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the switch.

aria.when: Set automatically from the on/off state.
Points at the description when there is one.
Required when there is no visible label.

accessibility.focus: A focus ring appears on the track when reached with the keyboard.

wcag.how: The label is a real <label> tied to the switch; the description is linked with aria-describedby.
Track and thumb colors keep 3:1 against their surroundings.
Focusable and toggled with Space or Enter.
Exposed as a switch with its label as the name and on/off as its value.

notes: State is shown by position and color, never by color alone.

examples.title: Setting switch
examples.description: A controlled switch with a label.
examples.code:
import { Switch } from '@ds/react';

<Switch label="Email notifications" checked={enabled} onCheckedChange={setEnabled} />

examples.title: With a description
examples.description: Extra detail is announced as the switch’s description.
examples.code:
import { Switch } from '@ds/react';

<Switch
  label="Real-time updates"
  description="Refreshes the dashboard every 30 seconds."
  defaultChecked
/>

examples.title: Settings list
examples.description: Labels at the start, switches aligned at the end.
examples.code: import { Switch } from '@ds/react';

related.relation: Use when the choice is applied with a Save button.
Use to pick one option from several.

changes: Replaces Toggle: a real switch (role="switch") with a label, description and keyboard support.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
Turns a setting on or off immediately, like a light switch. For choices that are only
applied after pressing Save, use a Checkbox instead.

checked.description: Whether the switch is on (controlled). Use with onCheckedChange.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the new state when the switch is toggled.

label.description:
Visible label saying what the switch controls, e.g. "Email notifications". Clicking it
toggles the switch. Without a label, pass aria-label.

description.description: Extra detail under the label; announced as the switch's description.

labelPosition.description: Side of the switch the label sits on. `end` (default) or `start` for settings lists.

--switch-on-bg-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--switch-on-hover-bg-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--switch-off-bg-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--switch-off-hover-bg-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--switch-label-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--switch-description-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--switch-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--switch-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--switch-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.

--switch-transition-duration.description: Small state changes: hover, press, toggle.

--switch-transition-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.

--switch-border-radius.description: Corner radius steps in px (see --radius-* in themes/radius.css).

--switch-thumb-border-radius.description: Corner radius steps in px (see --radius-* in themes/radius.css).
